info.name: SpotHero Parking Availability Reservations API
info.description:
The SpotHero Parking API provides programmatic access to the largest network of off-street parking facilities in North America. Partners can search for available parking spots, check real-time availability, create and manage reservations, and access facility details including pricing, amenities, and directions. The API supports navigation apps, mobility platforms, connected car dashboards, event ticketing systems, and enterprise fleet management solutions.

Contact Support:
 Name: SpotHero Partner Support
 Email: partner.support@spothero.com
